description: This file defines the 'MarkAttendanceScreen' widget, a Flutter StatefulWidget responsible for managing and marking attendance for courses and sessions. It includes UI components for selecting courses and sessions, creating new sessions, displaying real-time attendance updates via SSE with polling fallback, and providing interfaces for marking students as present, absent, or late.

classes.name: MarkAttendanceScreen
classes.description: A StatefulWidget that provides UI and logic for selecting courses and sessions, creating sessions, real-time attendance updates via SSE with polling fallback, and marking attendance for students.

methods.name: initState
methods.description: Initializes the widget state and calls _bootstrap to load the initial course data.

methods.name: _bootstrap
methods.description: Loads the list of courses from the API and manages loading/error states.

methods.name: _loadSessions
methods.description: Fetches sessions for the selected course.

methods.name: _loadAttendance
methods.description: Fetches attendance details for the selected session.

methods.name: _createSession
methods.description: Creates a new session for the selected course with the current date.

methods.name: _onSelectCourseChanged
methods.description: Handles change of selected course, resets session and attendance, then loads sessions.

methods.name: _onSelectSessionChanged
methods.description: Handles change of selected session, resets attendance, loads attendance, and sets up real-time updates.

methods.name: _setupRealtime
methods.description: Attempts to establish SSE connection for real-time updates, falling back to polling if SSE fails or times out.

methods.name: _startPolling
methods.description: Starts periodic polling of attendance data when real-time updates via SSE are unavailable.

methods.name: _teardownRealtime
methods.description: Cancels SSE subscriptions and polling timers to clean up real-time update mechanisms.

methods.name: _onMark
methods.description: Marks a student's attendance status and refreshes data.
